name: Kusuriyubi no Kyoukasho 2
source:
It's a new school year for our guy. He is feeling a bit down since he doesn't have a girlfriend. He met a guy (main guy from #1?) who soon became his friend. He has to invite a girl to their new lunch club. Which of the 5 girls will he pick? After that, there is summer and winter loving to enjoy.

[Edited from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
新学年开始了。主角因为没有女朋友，心情有些低落。他遇见一名男子——也许是前作主角？——两人很快成为朋友。主角必须邀请一名女孩加入新成立的午餐社团。五名女孩之中，他会选择谁？此后，还有夏日与冬日的恋情等待玩家享受。

[编译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
